blocks.text: Oldingi darsda (→ 47-dars) asosiy qoida o'tildi: «aytish» fe'li o'tgan zamonda bo'lsa, fe'l bir pog'ona orqaga suriladi. Lekin bu qoida majburiy emas. Agar aytilgan narsa **hozir ham rost** bo'lsa (u hali ham o'sha yerda yashaydi, muzey hali ham dushanbada yopiq), zamonni o'zgartirmasa ham bo'ladi: Tom said he **lives** near the airport. Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri: lives — «hozir ham shunday» deganimizni ta'kidlaydi, lived — shunchaki aytilgan gapni yetkazadi.

Aksincha, agar aytilgan gap **haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmasa** yoki vaziyat o'zgargan bo'lsa, backshift **majburiy**: You said you **were** at home, but I saw you in town! Bu yerda «are» deyish mumkin emas, chunki biz u gap noto'g'ri bo'lib chiqqanini ko'rsatyapmiz. O'zbekchada bunday holatda «**... degan eding**-ku», «**... aytgan edi**» ishlatiladi.

rows: Tom said he **lives / lived** near the airport.
The guide said the palace **is** closed on Tuesdays.
You said you **were** at home, but you weren't!
He said he **didn't sleep / hadn't slept** well.

items.text: Tom **said** he **lives** near the airport, so he can give us a lift.
items.translation: Tom aeroport yaqinida **yashashini aytdi**, demak, bizni olib ketishi mumkin.

items.text: The guide **said** the palace **is** closed on Tuesdays.
items.translation: Gid saroy seshanba kunlari **yopiq bo'lishini aytdi**.

items.text: You **said** you **were** at home, but I saw you in town!

blocks.text: Agar «aytish» fe'lining o'zi hozirgi zamonda (**says**, **has said**, **will say**) bo'lsa, hech narsa surilmaydi: Kate **says** she**'s** going to be late. Bu juda ko'p uchraydi: telefonda gapni darhol yetkazganda (Dad **says** dinner **is** ready), xat, e'lon yoki yozuv mazmunini aytganda (The sign **says** ...), birovning doimiy fikrini aytganda (My doctor always **says** ...).

items.text: Kate **says** she**'s** going to be about ten minutes late.
The sign **says** parking **is** free after six in the evening.
items.translation: Yozuvda kechqurun soat oltidan keyin to'xtash joyi **bepul deyilgan**.

items.text: Mum **has said** we **can** stay up late tonight.

blocks.text: Buyruq va iltimos: tell / ask somebody to ...

Buyruq, ko'rsatma va iltimos o'zlashtirma gapda **to + infinitiv** bilan beriladi: "Sit down!" → He **told** me **to sit** down. "Could you help me?" → She **asked** me **to help** her. Inkorda — **not to**: "Don't be late!" → She **told** us **not to be** late. Bu yerda zamon surilishi yo'q, chunki infinitivda zamon bo'lmaydi. O'zbekchada esa bunday gap «-ishimni / -maslikni + aytdi / so'radi» bilan quriladi: o'tir**ishimni** aytdi, kech qol**maslikni** aytdi. Narsa so'ralsa — **ask for**: "Can I have the bill?" → He **asked for** the bill.

rows: He **offered to carry** it for me.

items.text: The nurse **told** me **to sit** down and wait for my name.
items.translation: Hamshira menga o'tirib, ismim chaqirilishini **kutishimni aytdi**.

items.text: Aziz **asked** me **to lend** him my laptop for the weekend.
items.translation: Aziz dam olish kunlariga noutbukimni qarzga **berib turishimni so'radi**.

items.text: Our parents **told** us **not to open** the door to strangers.

blocks.text: Boshqa fe'llar: advise, remind, warn ... va offer, promise, refuse

say va tell o'rniga ko'pincha aniqroq fe'l tanlanadi. Ikki guruh bor. **Fe'l + odam + to**: advise (maslahat berdi), remind (eslatdi), warn (ogohlantirdi), invite (taklif qildi), encourage (undadi), persuade (ko'ndirdi), order (buyurdi), beg (yolvordi) — batafsil → 55-dars. **Fe'l + to** (odamsiz): offer (o'zi qilishni taklif qildi), promise (va'da berdi), refuse (bosh tortdi), agree (rozi bo'ldi), threaten (do'q qildi): He **offered to** help — «I'll help you» degani.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «He said me to wait» → He **told** me **to wait** (say + odam + to bo'lmaydi); «She told to me to sit» → She **told me to** sit (tell dan keyin to yo'q); «He asked me that I close the door» → He asked me **to close** the door; «I told him don't go» → I told him **not to go**; «She said to not worry» → She told us **not to** worry; «He offered me to help» → He **offered to help** me (offer + to).

Buyruq gapni o'zlashtirishning eng oson yo'li: buyruq fe'lining oldiga **to** qo'ying (Wait! → **to wait**), «Don't» ni **not to** ga almashtiring (Don't wait! → **not to wait**), oldiga esa **told / asked + odam** qo'shing.

rows: Hali ham rost — surish shart emas
She said she **works / worked** in a bank.
You said you **were** ill, but you're fine!
Iltimos: asked somebody to / asked for
He **asked** me **to help**. He **asked for** water.
advise / remind / warn somebody to; offer / promise / refuse to
He **reminded** me **to call**. She **refused to** pay.

examples.title: Still true: she **said** she **lives** in Edinburgh
examples.description: Aytilgan gap hozir ham rost bo'lsa, zamonni surish shart emas: umumiy faktlar, jadvallar, hali o'zgarmagan holatlar.

sentences.text: Kate **said** she **lives** in Edinburgh now, so we should visit her there.
sentences.translation: Keyt hozir Edinburgda **yashashini aytdi**, shuning uchun uni o'sha yerda ziyorat qilishimiz kerak.

sentences.text: Our guide **told** us that the Kalyan Minaret **is** almost fifty metres tall.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz Minorai Kalon qariyb ellik metr **balandlikda ekanini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **said** he **doesn't** eat meat, so I've ordered him a vegetable dish.
sentences.translation: Jasur go'sht **yemasligini aytdi**, shuning uchun unga sabzavotli taom buyurtma qildim.

sentences.text: The receptionist **said** breakfast **is** served until ten, so we've still got time.
sentences.translation: Qabulxona xodimi nonushta soat o'ngacha **berilishini aytdi**, demak, hali vaqtimiz bor.

sentences.text: My son's teacher **told** me he **is** one of the best pupils in the class.
sentences.translation: O'g'limning o'qituvchisi u sinfdagi eng yaxshi o'quvchilardan **biri ekanini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Our physics teacher **explained** that light **travels** much faster than sound.
sentences.translation: Fizika o'qituvchimiz yorug'lik tovushdan ancha tez **tarqalishini tushuntirdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **said** her husband **works** for a bank, but I don't remember which one.
sentences.translation: Madina eri bankda **ishlashini aytdi**, lekin qaysi bankda ekanini eslay olmayapman.

sentences.text: Tom **told** me the new café on the corner **does** the best coffee in town.
sentences.translation: Tom muyulishdagi yangi kafe shahardagi eng zo'r qahvani **tayyorlashini aytdi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **said** he**'s** going to Samarkand next week, so he won't be at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Aziz kelasi hafta Samarqandga **ketayotganini aytdi**, shuning uchun u yig'ilishda bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: When I asked for directions, a woman **said** the station **is** just round the corner.
sentences.translation: Yo'l so'raganimda, bir ayol vokzal shundoq **muyulishda ekanini aytdi**.

examples.title: Different from reality: you **said** you **were** ...
examples.description: Aytilgan gap haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmasa yoki vaziyat o'zgargan bo'lsa — backshift majburiy. O'zbekchada «... degan eding-ku».

sentences.text: You **said** you **were** a vegetarian — so why are you eating a burger?
sentences.translation: **Vegetarianman degan eding**-ku — unda nega burger yeyapsan?

sentences.text: Hi, Sarah! I thought you were in Spain — Kate **said** you **were** on holiday.
sentences.translation: Salom, Sara! Ispaniyadasan deb o'ylagandim — Keyt **ta'tildaligingni aytgan edi**.

sentences.text: The website **said** the museum **was** open on Mondays, but it's closed!
sentences.translation: Saytda muzey dushanba kunlari **ochiq deyilgan edi**, lekin u yopiq-ku!

sentences.text: Bekzod **told** me the exam **was** easy, but I found it really difficult.
sentences.translation: Bekzod imtihon **oson ekanini aytgan edi**, lekin menga juda qiyin tuyuldi.

sentences.text: The advert **said** the flat **had** two bedrooms, but there's only one.
sentences.translation: E'londa kvartirada ikkita yotoqxona **borligi yozilgan edi**, lekin faqat bitta ekan.

sentences.text: I'm surprised to see you here — your mum **said** you **were** ill in bed.
sentences.translation: Seni bu yerda ko'rib hayron bo'ldim — onang **kasal yotganingni aytgan edi**.

sentences.text: Jasur **said** he **didn't** know Emma, but I saw them having lunch together.
sentences.translation: Jasur Emmani **tanimasligini aytgan edi**, lekin ularni birga tushlik qilayotganini ko'rdim.

sentences.text: Why are you still here? You **said** you **had** a train to catch at six!
sentences.translation: Nega hali ham shu yerdasan? Soat oltidagi **poyezdga ulgurishim kerak degan eding**-ku!

sentences.text: Madina **told** everyone she **was** twenty-five, but actually she's thirty.
sentences.translation: Madina hammaga **yigirma beshdaman degan edi**, aslida esa o'ttizda.

sentences.text: Oliver **said** the restaurant **wasn't** expensive, yet the bill came to two hundred pounds.
sentences.translation: Oliver restoran **qimmat emasligini aytgan edi**, biroq hisob ikki yuz funtga yetdi.

examples.title: Reporting now: **says**, **has told me**, **'ll say**
examples.description: «Aytish» fe'li hozirgi zamonda (says, has said, will say) bo'lsa, hech narsa surilmaydi: telefonda, xat va yozuvlarda, doimiy fikrlarda.

sentences.text: Mum **says** dinner **is** ready, so come downstairs now.
sentences.translation: Oyim kechki ovqat **tayyorligini aytyapti**, endi pastga tushinglar.

sentences.text: Aziz **says** he**'ll** be about twenty minutes late because of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Aziz tirbandlik sababli yigirma daqiqacha **kechikishini aytyapti**.

sentences.text: The forecast **says** it**'s going to** rain all weekend in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra, Manchesterda butun dam olish kunlari **yomg'ir yog'ar ekan**.

sentences.text: Emma **has told** me she**'s** thinking of leaving her job.
sentences.translation: Emma menga ishdan ketishni **o'ylayotganini aytdi**.

sentences.text: What **does** the letter **say**? — It **says** we have to pay by Friday.
sentences.translation: Xatda nima **deyilgan**? — Jumagacha to'lashimiz kerakligi **yozilgan**.

sentences.text: My doctor **keeps saying** I **need** to lose some weight.
sentences.translation: Shifokorim doim biroz ozishim **kerakligini aytadi**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **writes** that she **is** enjoying her course in London very much.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza Londondagi kursi unga juda **yoqayotganini yozyapti**.

sentences.text: Everyone **says** the new metro line **has made** life much easier.
sentences.translation: Hamma yangi metro liniyasi hayotni ancha **osonlashtirganini aytyapti**.

sentences.text: If anyone asks, I**'ll say** you **are** in a meeting.
sentences.translation: Kimdir so'rasa, **yig'ilishda deyman**.

sentences.text: The instructions **say** you **shouldn't** use this cleaner on wooden floors.
sentences.translation: Yo'riqnomada bu tozalagichni yog'och polda **ishlatmaslik kerakligi yozilgan**.

examples.title: **told** me **to** ...: orders and instructions
examples.description: Buyruq va ko'rsatma: tell + odam + to + fe'l. O'zbekchada «-ishimni aytdi», «-ishni buyurdi», «tayinladi».

sentences.text: The police officer **told** us **to move** the car immediately.
sentences.translation: Politsiyachi mashinani darhol **olib qo'yishimizni buyurdi**.

sentences.text: My boss **told** me **to send** the contract to the client by five.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'im shartnomani soat beshgacha mijozga **yuborishimni aytdi**.

sentences.text: The doctor **told** Aziz **to stay** in bed for at least three days.
sentences.translation: Shifokor Azizga kamida uch kun **yotib turishni buyurdi**.

sentences.text: Who **told** you **to come** here so early?
sentences.translation: Bu yerga bunchalik erta **kelishingni** kim **aytdi**?

sentences.text: Our coach **told** the players **to keep** the ball on the ground.
sentences.translation: Murabbiyimiz o'yinchilarga to'pni yerdan **oshirmaslikni aytdi**.

sentences.text: Dad always **told** me **to switch off** the lights when I left a room.
sentences.translation: Dadam doim xonadan chiqqanimda chiroqlarni **o'chirishimni aytardi**.

sentences.text: The officer **ordered** the soldiers **to cross** the river before dawn.
sentences.translation: Ofitser askarlarga tong otmasdan daryodan **o'tishni buyurdi**.

sentences.text: Kate's mother **told** her **to be** home before midnight.
sentences.translation: Keytning onasi unga yarim tundan oldin uyda **bo'lishini tayinladi**.

sentences.text: Teachers usually **tell** students **to check** their answers before handing in the test.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchilar odatda talabalarga testni topshirishdan oldin **javoblarini tekshirishni aytadi**.

sentences.text: When we arrived, the receptionist **told** us **to wait** in the lobby until our room was ready.
sentences.translation: Kelganimizda qabulxona xodimi xonamiz tayyor bo'lguncha vestibyulda **kutib turishimizni aytdi**.

examples.title: **asked** me **to** ... / **asked for**: requests
examples.description: Iltimos: ask + odam + to + fe'l; narsa so'ralsa — ask for + ot. Majhul shakli — I was asked to ...

sentences.text: Nilufar **asked** me **to help** her move the furniture on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Nilufar shanba kuni mebellarni ko'chirishga **yordam berishimni so'radi**.

sentences.text: A tourist **asked** me **to take** a photo of her family in front of the Registan.
sentences.translation: Bir sayyoh Registon oldida oilasini **suratga olib berishimni so'radi**.

sentences.text: The passengers **asked** the driver **to turn** the air conditioning up.
sentences.translation: Yo'lovchilar haydovchidan konditsionerni **kuchaytirishni so'rashdi**.

sentences.text: James **asked for** the bill and paid with his card.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **hisobni so'radi** va karta bilan to'ladi.

sentences.text: Can you **ask** Sarah **to call** me when she gets back?
sentences.translation: Sara qaytib kelganda, menga **qo'ng'iroq qilsin deb aytib qo'yasizmi**?

sentences.text: My neighbour **asked** us **to keep** an eye on his flat while he was in Turkey.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnim Turkiyada bo'lganida kvartirasiga **qarab turishimizni so'radi**.

sentences.text: Several students **asked for** more time to finish the project.
sentences.translation: Bir nechta talaba loyihani tugatish uchun **ko'proq vaqt so'radi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod's grandmother **asked** him **to read** the letter aloud because she had forgotten her glasses.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning buvisi ko'zoynagini unutib qo'ygani uchun undan xatni ovoz chiqarib **o'qib berishini so'radi**.

sentences.text: When the meeting started, the chairman **asked** everyone **to introduce** themselves.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish boshlanganda rais hammadan **o'zini tanishtirishni so'radi**.

sentences.text: I **was asked to** give a short speech at my cousin's wedding.
sentences.translation: Amakivachchamning to'yida qisqa **nutq so'zlashimni so'rashdi**.

examples.title: **not to**: told us not to, asked him not to
examples.description: Inkor buyruq va iltimos: tell / ask + odam + not to + fe'l. O'zbekchada «-maslikni aytdi», «-masligimni so'radi».

sentences.text: The doctor **told** me **not to lift** anything heavy for a month.
sentences.translation: Shifokor bir oy davomida og'ir narsa **ko'tarmasligimni aytdi**.

sentences.text: I **asked** the children **not to make** so much noise, but they didn't listen.
sentences.translation: Bolalardan bunchalik **shovqin qilmaslikni so'radim**, lekin ular quloq solmadi.

sentences.text: Kate **told** her brother **not to tell** anyone about her new job.
sentences.translation: Keyt akasiga yangi ishi haqida hech kimga **aytmaslikni tayinladi**.

sentences.text: We **were told not to** take photos inside the palace.
sentences.translation: Bizga saroy ichida **suratga olmaslikni aytishdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur's father **warned** him **not to drive** too fast on the mountain roads.
sentences.translation: Jasurning otasi uni tog' yo'llarida juda tez **haydamaslik haqida ogohlantirdi**.

sentences.text: Madina **asked** me **not to call** after ten because the baby goes to sleep early.
sentences.translation: Madina chaqaloq erta uxlagani uchun soat o'ndan keyin **qo'ng'iroq qilmasligimni so'radi**.

sentences.text: Why did you eat the cake? I **told** you **not to touch** it!
sentences.translation: Nega tortni yeding? Senga unga **tegmaslikni aytgandim**-ku!

sentences.text: The guide **reminded** us **not to leave** our bags on the bus.
sentences.translation: Gid sumkalarimizni avtobusda **qoldirmaslikni eslatdi**.

sentences.text: Emma **begged** her husband **not to sell** the old family house.
sentences.translation: Emma eridan eski oilaviy uyni **sotmaslikni yolvorib so'radi**.

sentences.text: Students **are asked not to** use their phones during lectures.
sentences.translation: Talabalardan ma'ruza paytida **telefon ishlatmaslik so'raladi**.

examples.title: **advised** me **to**, **offered to**, **refused to**
examples.description: advise, remind, invite, encourage, persuade, warn + odam + to; offer, promise, refuse, agree + to (odamsiz).

sentences.text: My teacher **advised** me **to read** English newspapers every day.
sentences.translation: O'qituvchim har kuni ingliz gazetalarini **o'qishni maslahat berdi**.

sentences.text: Can you **remind** me **to buy** bread on the way home?
sentences.translation: Uyga qaytayotganda non **olishimni eslatib qo'ya olasizmi**?

sentences.text: Aziz **invited** us **to stay** at his house in Fergana for the holidays.
sentences.translation: Aziz bizni ta'tilda Farg'onadagi uyida **qolishga taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: Our neighbour **offered to** water our plants while we were away.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnimiz biz yo'qligimizda gullarimizni **sug'orib turishni taklif qildi**.

sentences.text: Oliver **promised to** bring the book back the next morning.
sentences.translation: Oliver kitobni ertasi kuni ertalab **qaytarib olib kelishga va'da berdi**.

sentences.text: The bank **refused to** give Jasur a loan because his salary was too low.
sentences.translation: Bank Jasurning maoshi juda past bo'lgani uchun unga **kredit berishdan bosh tortdi**.

sentences.text: Sarah's parents **encouraged** her **to apply** for the job in London.
sentences.translation: Saraning ota-onasi uni Londondagi ishga **hujjat topshirishga undashdi**.

sentences.text: After a long discussion, the landlord **agreed to** lower the rent.
sentences.translation: Uzoq muhokamadan keyin uy egasi ijara haqini **pasaytirishga rozi bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Who **persuaded** you **to buy** such an expensive phone?
sentences.translation: Bunday qimmat telefon **sotib olishga** sizni kim **ko'ndirdi**?

sentences.text: Dilnoza **warned** us **to take** warm clothes because nights in the desert are cold.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza cho'lda kechalari sovuq bo'lgani uchun **issiq kiyim olishimizni tayinladi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: a message from the manager
examples.description: Ikki hamkasb suhbati: rost bo'lib qolgan gap (starts), o'zgargan gap (was), says, asked us to, told everyone not to, promised to.

sentences.text: — Did the manager **say** anything about the meeting tomorrow?
sentences.translation: — Menejer ertangi yig'ilish haqida biror narsa **dedimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, she **said** it **starts** at nine, not at ten as usual.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yig'ilish odatdagidek o'nda emas, to'qqizda **boshlanishini aytdi**.

sentences.text: — Really? She **told** me last week it **was** at ten.
sentences.translation: — Rostdanmi? O'tgan hafta menga o'nda **bo'lishini aytgan edi**.

sentences.text: — Well, she's changed it. She also **asked** us **to bring** our sales figures.
sentences.translation: — Demak, o'zgartiribdi. Savdo ko'rsatkichlarimizni ham **olib kelishimizni so'radi**.

sentences.text: — Did she **mention** the new project in Samarkand at all?
sentences.translation: — Samarqanddagi yangi loyihani umuman **tilga oldimi**?

sentences.text: — She **says** it**'s been** approved, but we **mustn't** tell the clients yet.
sentences.translation: — Loyiha **tasdiqlanganini**, lekin hozircha mijozlarga **aytmasligimiz kerakligini aytyapti**.

sentences.text: — Fine. Oh, and Tom **asked** me **to remind** you about his leaving party.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Aytgancha, Tom senga xayrlashuv ziyofatini **eslatib qo'yishimni so'radi**.

sentences.text: — I haven't forgotten! He **told** everyone **not to bring** expensive presents.
sentences.translation: — Unutganim yo'q! U hammaga qimmat sovg'a **olib kelmaslikni aytdi**.

sentences.text: — Good, because I **promised to** organise a card from the whole team.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi, chunki butun jamoa nomidan otkritka **tayyorlashga va'da berganman**.

sentences.text: — Great. I**'ll tell** Tom you**'re** helping — he'll be really pleased.
sentences.translation: — Zo'r. Tomga **yordam berayotganingni aytaman** — juda xursand bo'ladi.
